title: NSA Utah data center code-named Bumblehive

tellings.quote: Yes. And what was interesting, so Utah data center, it's now declassified this code name. What the NSA set up then the largest sort of single data center in Utah back in the 2005s, something like that. And the code name for it was Bumblehive.

plain: Around 2005 the National Security Agency, the US agency that intercepts communications, built what was then the largest single data center in Utah, and its now declassified code name was Bumblehive. A researcher named Matthew Pines tells this, without naming a source, as a code name he finds interesting.
